component.name: Showberry
component.summary: Browse and stream movies and TV series

description.p: Showberry is a modern movie and TV series streaming application for GNOME. It uses TMDB for movie and series metadata and supports multiple streaming providers with MPV playback.

ul.li: Browse trending and popular movies and series from TMDB
Search for any title with instant results
Stream movies and TV series using MPV with hardware acceleration
Torrent P2P streaming with background buffering and file selection

screenshot.caption: Browse trending and popular movies with release info and ratings
Library view featuring continue watching progress and custom watchlist
Rich movie details with high-resolution backdrops, cast, and overview
TV series catalogue with network badges and season counts
Season and episode picker with detailed synopsis and direct streaming
Preferences dialog for custom TMDB keys, providers, and torrent caching

description.p: Bugfix release restoring smooth keyboard navigation:

ul.li: Fixed Watchlist to Continue Watching and header tabs UP navigation
Fixed vertical column alignment when pressing DOWN in Movies and TV grids
Ensured smooth viewport scroll restoration when moving between sections
